name: Extra Commander’s Aura
body:
You manage to maintain your commander’s aura for longer than others.

Prerequisite(s): Commander’s aura class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use your commander’s aura for an additional 6 rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Commander’s Aura multiple times. Its effects stack.
